subject: Post-demo security follow-up & subprocessor kickoff — Atlas Health
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security follow-up & subprocessor kickoff — Atlas Health

Sophie — thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps on the compliance items we discussed so your security team has what they need to evaluate Redwood: 

Summary of what we covered
- Use case: patient-facing summarization + internal analytics (PII/PHI in scope)
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA/BAA options, subprocessor footprint and data flow boundaries

Ask / next steps (proposed)
1) Can you share the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or redacted report) and any HIPAA/BAA posture notes?
2) Please confirm a preliminary subprocessor list (cloud providers, analytics, monitoring tools) and which subprocessors touch PHI.
3) We attached our short vendor security questionnaire and a data-flow template — could you have your security or compliance lead fill and return the questionnaire and the data-flow diagram? (Attaching: Redwood-Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.pdf, data-flow-template.xlsx)
4) If easier, we can set up a 30-min call with Rishi (security) and Monica (customer success) next week to walk through specifics.

Requested timeline: ideally we get the SOC2 or a redacted copy and the subprocessor list by EOD Friday (6/25) so we can complete the internal risk review before contract review.

Thanks — I’ll coordinate once I have your security contact.

— Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[hannah.schmitt@redwood.com] | +1 415-555-0123
[Attachment: Redwood-Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)]
[Attachment: data-flow-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@atlashealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bates <tom.bates@atlashealth.com>, security@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo security follow-up & subprocessor kickoff — Atlas Health

Hi Hannah — great meeting, thanks. Looping in Tom Bates (Head of Security) and our shared security alias. High-level status below and I've attached our current subprocessor export.

SOC 2 / HIPAA status
- SOC 2 Type II: in progress; final report expected to be available (redacted) by Fri 6/25. We can provide a SOC 2 bridge letter earlier if helpful.
- HIPAA: Atlas is a business associate for certain products; we can discuss BAA terms. Our legal team prefers to do a standard BAA via DocuSign (I can send a link).

Preliminary subprocessors (attached CSV contains full rows). Quick call-out:
- AWS (us-east-1) — infrastructure, primary storage (S3/EKS)
- Snowflake (US-Central) — analytics warehouse (PHI segregated to a separate account)
- Datadog — metrics/monitoring (no PHI)
- Sentry — error reporting (PII masked, no PHI)
- Okta — IdP (SAML)

We will upload our compliance pack (redacted SOC blurb, controls matrix) to a secure share and grant access to the Redwood security mailbox by EOD Wednesday. Link: https://files.atlashealth.com/redwood/secure-share/7421

Tom — can you confirm the right person to fill Redwood's questionnaire? If you want, we can have our compliance analyst fill it and return.

Thanks, Sophie
Sophie Turner
Director of Product, Atlas Health
[Attachment: Atlas_Subprocessors_20270621.csv (text/csv)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo security follow-up & subprocessor kickoff — Atlas Health

Rishi / Monica — forwarding the thread from Atlas Health. Key asks: redacted SOC 2 by 6/25, preliminary subprocessor list attached, and they will share a secure compliance pack link by Wed.

Why this is higher priority:
- PHI in scope for their primary workload (patient summaries).
- Snowflake noted as PHI store in separate account — need to validate access boundaries and encryption practices.

Suggested immediate actions:
1) Rishi to review the attached CSV for any high-risk subprocessors and confirm whether a BAA is required for Snowflake usage as they described.
2) Monica to offer a 30-min walkthrough with Atlas security and confirm Redwood's data segmentation controls and encryption-at-rest approach.
3) If SOC2 not available by 6/25, request bridge letter and sample control evidence (audit logs) so procurement can proceed.

Hannah

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 10:32:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-demo security follow-up & subprocessor kickoff — Atlas Health

Thanks for the ping. Quick checklist / info we need from Atlas before we sign off on any procurement/po terms:
1) SOC 2 Type II (redacted) or bridge letter — target delivery 6/25 as requested. If delayed, we need an ETA and sample control evidence (especially around access logs and incident response).
2) Complete subprocessor table with: vendor name, function (storage, monitoring, analytics), whether they handle PHI, data location, and a point of contact. The CSV is a good start; ask for the missing columns above.
3) Data flow diagram covering: where PHI is collected, which components see PHI (front-end, backend, analytics), and any cross-account access to Snowflake. Please use the attached data-flow-template.xlsx and return it.
4) Encryption details: KMS provider, whether customer-managed keys are used, and key rotation policy.
5) Retention and deletion policy for PHI, and evidence of access reviews/least privilege.

Operational asks for Karthik 
- Karthik: please book 30-min technical review with Tom (Atlas) for Thurs/Fri next week. Include Nicole from infra if needed.

Priority: HIGH. If Atlas can deliver items 1–3 by Fri 6/25 we can move to legal for BAA and procurement.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
[rishi.malhotra@redwood.com]

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@atlashealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Bates <tom.bates@atlashealth.com>, security@atlashealth.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 12:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo security follow-up & subprocessor kickoff — Atlas Health

Rishi / Hannah — thanks, we pulled together a slightly expanded package and CSV. Quick answers inline + attachments/upload: 

SOC 2 / Bridge
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II: finalizing; we will share a redacted PDF by Fri 6/25. In the meantime, we've uploaded a controls matrix and a bridge letter to the secure share.

Subprocessors (summary) — full CSV attached (Atlas_Subprocessors_20270623.csv)
- AWS (infrastructure/storage) — handles PHI (S3), data isolated in a dedicated account for PHI workloads.
- Snowflake (analytics) — handles PHI, dedicated Snowflake account, RBAC enforced, no cross-tenant access.
- Datadog (monitoring) — no PHI, logs scrubbing enabled.
- Sentry (errors) — PII masked at source, no PHI.
- Okta (auth) — identity provider, no PHI stored.
- Segment (event data) — pseudonymized, no PHI stored in Segment; raw PHI flows directly to Snowflake.

Data flow pack and compliance zip
- Uploaded: Atlas_Compliance_Pack_20270623.zip to our secure share (Redwood access granted to security@redwood.com). Link: https://files.atlashealth.com/redwood/secure-share/7421/compliance.zip

BAA and next steps
- I'll kick off a DocuSign for a standard BAA and send the link to Hannah and legal. Expect the DocuSign for review by Thu 6/24: https://app.docusign.com/agreements/AA-Atlas-BAA-20270623

We should be able to have the full redacted SOC2 and final CSV by Fri 6/25. If you need anything earlier, let me know and Tom can run a quick call with our compliance analyst to walk through any high-priority controls.

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Turner
Director of Product | Atlas Health
